Where these places come from

The suggestions come from official registers of places of care. The list is kept inside the app and searched on this phone. For the app, the registers were filtered to places a patient can visit, and their kinds of care regrouped into the kinds of doctor the app knows. The location button at the end of the Place field lists only places that offer the care chosen for this visit, or every place when the visit is to another doctor; typing a name searches them all.

For a screening, the list shows the departments where it is often done: gynaecology for cervical screening, imaging for mammography, gastroenterology for bowel screening. A register does not say whether a department does that screening itself, so ask when you book.

The list covers Czechia, Ukraine and the United Arab Emirates. In Ukraine it holds only places with a contract with the National Health Service of Ukraine. In the Emirates it holds the Dubai register in its December 2023 edition, the licensed places of Abu Dhabi as they were mapped in 2022 and are still mapped in 2026, and the public hospitals and health centres of Emirates Health Services; private clinics in Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Ras Al Khaimah and Fujairah are not on it. A register can be out of date: check with the place before you go.

The location button asks Android for your approximate location once and rounds it to about a kilometre. It is used on this phone to sort the list, is never saved or sent anywhere, and is forgotten when you leave this page.
